divergences.old: deps frisk --source osv scanning the git repository's manifests itself
divergences.toil: toil osv vulns checks an inventory: toil deps scan output from --from <file> or stdin (toil deps scan --include-transitive | toil osv vulns). The --ecosystem, --direct-only and --include-dev filters apply to that inventory
divergences.why: One command does one thing against one source; the scan is its own command and the sources compose with it (docs/integrations.md, dependency analysis).

divergences.old: deps frisk probing Artifactory's reachability, as well as OSV.dev's, before every run
divergences.toil: toil osv vulns probes OSV.dev only, as before, and never contacts Artifactory. tier is still "full" on every success, as it always was once OSV.dev answered
divergences.why: A command talks only to the public API it names in its own name.

divergences.old: deps frisk --source osv mapping querybatch's answer as full records, which carries only id and modified, so every finding had an empty summary, UNKNOWN severity and "No fix available"
divergences.toil: After querybatch, toil osv vulns fetches each distinct id's full record (GET /v1/vulns/{id}, eight at a time) and fills summary, severity, cvss, aliases, references and remediation from it. The data fields keep their names; their values are now real. A record that can't be fetched fails the command, naming the id
divergences.why: Confirmed against the live OSV.dev API on 2026-10-17 (PR #130's proof run: 12 findings, every one empty), so it is fixed as a declared change (#91 item 5; CLAUDE.md, Matching the predecessor).
